'''Prejad''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who fought on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Prejad and two other [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lords, [[Wenom]] and [[Shados]], [[Death/Legends|killed]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Alien/Legends|alien]] commandos and took over their forward camp, leading the Republic to counterstrike and kill the three. Prejad wielded a red [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]].
